column1: # Shared storage initialization and parameterized octal/hex completion.
# Caller supplies ibytes and INITADDR storage descriptor for automatic/global/block-static arrays.
# Zero-fill first; store decoded elements at width dw and a fitting NUL; NEXT runs once.
# Walk consumes [ps,pe-1), including its prefix; resume at $walk_w. Escape decoding is shared.
# C initstr writes wide code points over the zero-filled array; it does not
# emit a second store for the terminating wide NUL.
# Row callers retain byte-relative ioff and provide str_base for shared address spelling.
